recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes stale active source that contradicted the already-applied StructureDefinition change; broader cleanup of deleted ImmunizationEvaluation/ImmunizationRecommendation model-info classes should be handled under the later resource-removal work if desired.
issue_request: FHIR-44982 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to change doseNumber and seriesDoses in Immunization, ImmunizationEvaluation, and ImmunizationRecommendation from string to CodeableConcept, not create example value sets, and update comments to allow coded concepts or free text.
initial_application: Commit 184c07f820c755a95cc4bc0c6b0f9483cc36b707 applied the main StructureDefinition changes for the three then-current immunization resources. Current Immunization source already had CodeableConcept comments and bindings, but the protocol example still used primitive value attributes and the active FHIR model-definition Library still exposed the old positiveInt/string type choices.
additional_context: Immunization remains active in source/fhir.ini. ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation were later removed from core source and are now linked externally/additionally, so their deleted StructureDefinition source was not restored. The active Library example still contains model-info classes for those artifacts, so its stale type metadata was kept aligned with FHIR-44982 without broad resource-removal cleanup.
reconciliation: Changed the Immunization protocol example to encode doseNumber and seriesDoses as CodeableConcept text, updated stale committee-note metadata on the Immunization elements to mention the later FHIR-44982 CodeableConcept decision, and updated the FHIR model-definition content plus embedded Library attachment so the affected immunization entries use FHIR.CodeableConcept.
